text:
Alice M: @channel pager — Aurelia Health (vpc-aurelia-prod) reporting widespread auth failures. User requests to their dedicated pool returning 401s with 'kid not found'. Started ~08:04 UTC, noticed after their recent key rotation. Please escalate.

inc-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - vpc-aurelia-prod - Auth failures - paged to oncall-sre. Incident link: https://incidents.redwood/3723456789

ben.prod: I'm on it, looking at the auth-bridge logs. Seeing repeated 401s and logs saying "jwks fetch 404" when we try to pull their JWKS after yesterday's rotation.

jordan.se: Confirmed. Their IdP published a new key but the tokens are still stamped with the old `kid`. JWKS endpoint returns both keys but the new entry is missing `kid` attribute, so signature verification fails.

Alice M: Customer impact: roughly 80% of API calls using recent tokens failing. Customer SRE engaged and on call. We should provide a quick mitigation while working root cause with them.

ben.prod: Mitigation options: 1) force auth-bridge to use cached JWKS (fast, low risk) 2) accept tokens by verifying against all keys (broader verification, slight security surface) 3) ask customer to re-issue tokens (may be slow). I'll attempt option #1 now.

ben.prod: Applying cached-JWKS override to route `vpc-aurelia-prod` now. Command I'm running:
```
redwood auth-bridge override jwks --tenant vpc-aurelia-prod --jwks-file /tmp/aurelia-prev-jwks.json --expire 1h
```

ops-bot: deploy started for service auth-bridge (us-west-2) canary 1/3.

ben.prod: Canary is healthy, introspection returning 200s. Rolling to 3/3. :thumbsup: (reaction :white_check_mark:)

Aurelia-SRE: We see immediate improvement for web clients, thank you. Some mobile clients still show failures — likely cached tokens/client caches.

jordan.se: Note this is a short-term band-aid. Root cause: their key rotation script didn't set `kid`. We'll need them to republish JWKS with proper kids or rotate tokens.

kai.l: Longer-term, we should add fallback behavior to auth-bridge: retry JWKS fetch with backoff and accept cached keys for a short period. I'll open a ticket RDW-INC-2026 to track.

Alice M: Oncall handoff in 30m to kai.l. Ben, please capture logs and commands in the incident ticket before handoff.

ben.prod: Logged artifacts: /tmp/aurelia-prev-jwks.json and curl outputs. Example verification command I ran:
```
curl -s https://idp.aurelia.example/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys'
# returned 2 keys; the new entry is missing the `kid` field
```

Aurelia-SRE: We found our rotation job omitted `kid` when writing the new key object. Fixing now and will push an updated JWKS with explicit `kid` mapping in ~12 minutes. Apologies.

ben.prod: Good. Once they push the corrected JWKS we should remove the override. Plan: remove when auth failure rate <2% for 5 continuous minutes.

ops-bot: Metric alert suppressed for incident 3723456789.

kai.l: Taking handoff. I'll watch the redeploy and validate tokens. @Aurelia-SRE please post when JWKS updated so I can validate.

Aurelia-SRE: JWKS updated and now includes `kid` fields. Verified tokens validate locally.

kai.l: Removing override now:
```
redwood auth-bridge override remove --tenant vpc-aurelia-prod
```

ops-bot: deploy completed — auth-bridge config reload succeeded.

ben.prod: Post-mitigation checks: introspection 200s, error rate down to 0.8% over the last 10 minutes. We'll keep monitoring and close after 1h stable.

Alice M: Postmortem owner: ben.prod. Action items assigned:
- RDW-OPS-139: add JWKS validation integration test to CI
- RDW-ENG-542: implement safe-fallback config in auth-bridge (cached-JWKS + retry)
- Update incident runbook with override commands and verification steps.
ETA for high-priority items: 1 week.

Aurelia-SRE: Thanks for the quick response. Please share the runbook steps and any logs we should keep for our audit.

ben.prod: I'll attach the artifact bundle to the ticket (curl outputs, /tmp/aurelia-prev-jwks.json, auth-bridge reload logs). Closing notes will include exact commands used and remediation timeline.

Alice M: Incident will be marked resolved after the stabilization window. Great collaboration everyone. (reaction :raised_hands:)
